zh-CN.name: REA 逆向分析
zh-CN.shortDesc: 基于证据分析二进制、软件包与应用行为。需另备受支持的 Node.js/npm、rea-agents CLI 或已注册的 REA MCP；原生分析等流程需另备目标相关工具及权限，商业提供方须另行授权付费。安装本技能仅提供指引，不安装工具或注册服务；依赖不可用时先处理阻碍，不编造结果。

en-US.name: REA: Reverse Engineer Anything
en-US.shortDesc: Evidence-led reverse analysis of binaries, packages and app behavior. Requires supported Node.js/npm and rea-agents CLI or a registered REA MCP server; target-specific tools, permissions and any commercial provider licenses are separate. Installing this skill only supplies instructions; it does not install tools or register services. Resolve missing dependencies before claiming results.
